name: Touhou: GensoPanic
summary: Fight as Sakuya against the fearsome hordes of yokai plaguing the land of Gensokyo; summon aid from the girls consumed by a mysterious black hole; and acquire items to boost your power—ranging from a cursed hat that enhances your attack to a small flower that continuously poisons your enemies—or, if you prefer, use defensive items to stave off imminent death; the choice is yours to make.
